editorial.blurb: Mild 2 Spicy brings authentic, flavorful Indian cuisine to Chicago with customizable heat levels and standout dishes that keep diners coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order family-style and customize your spice level from mild to vindaloo—ask your server for recommendations like the butter chicken dosa or the NEW Karam Kick Dosa with potato masala for just $1 extra.
